summary:
[  edit  ]
The Render Pick  CHOP  samples a rendering (from a  Render TOP  or a  Render Pass TOP ) and returns 3D information from the geometry at that particular pick location. Values sampled can include position, normals, point color, texture coordinates, depth and the object's path.	An  Info DAT  should be used to retrieve the object's path.
The pick location is specified through uv coordinates of the rendering. These uv coordinates can be selected by clicking on a  Panel Component  or explicitly setting them in the U and V parameters in the Render Pick  CHOP .
Along with the geometric data returned, this node has two channels 'picked' and 'trigger' that inform the picked status. 'picked' will be 1 when an object has been found at the search location. 'trigger' will be 1 when both an object has been found, and the 'Picking By' condition has been met. That is, either the ' Panel Value ' is 1, or the 'Select' parmeter is 'On.
See also the multi-sample  Render Pick DAT .

parameters.label: Strategy
parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: ⊞  - Decides when to update values based on pick interactions.

parameters.label: Hold First Picked
parameters.name: holdfirst
parameters.description: Holds the values first returned when geometry picked.

parameters.label: Hold Last Picked
parameters.name: holdlast
parameters.description: Holds the values last returned when geometry picked. This differs from the Continuous strategy in that it will hold the last values picked on geometry if the pick starts sampling empty space (no geometry in that part of the scene). Alternatively, using the Continuous strategy the values will be cleared to zero if the pick starts sampling empty space.

parameters.label: Clear Previous Pick on New Pick
parameters.name: clearprev
parameters.description: This parameter is only enabled when the Strategy is set to Hold Last Picked. When this is on, starting a new pick on empty space will clear the values. When off, the last values will be held if the pick starts on empty space.

parameters.label: Response Time
parameters.name: responsetime
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines when the values are updated.

parameters.label: Next  Cook  (Faster)
parameters.name: nextcook
parameters.description: The values are captured on the current frame and updated next frame. Results are from the previous frame, but much faster cook times.

parameters.label: This  Cook  (Slower)
parameters.name: thiscook
parameters.description: The values are captured and updated in the current frame.

parameters.label: Pick Radius
parameters.name: pickradius
parameters.description: Controls the radius of the search area for the pick. If nothing is found at the pick's center it will keep searching for geometry in the search area defined by the Pick Radius.

parameters.label: Pick Radial Step
parameters.name: pickradstep
parameters.description: Used to reduce the searching within the search area. The search area is sampled at locations that correspond to 'spokes' outwards from the center pick point.

parameters.label: Pick Circular Step
parameters.name: pickcirstep
parameters.description: Used to reduce the searching within the search area. The search area is sampled at locations that correspond to 'rings' outwards from the center pick point.

parameters.label: Render/RenderPass  TOP
parameters.name: rendertop
parameters.description: Specifies which render to sample.

parameters.label: Use Pickable Flags
parameters.name: usepickableflags
parameters.description: When turned on only geometry whose  Pickable Flag  is on can be selected by the Render Pick  CHOP . The  Pickable Flag  is found on all  Object  components.

parameters.label: Include Non-Pickable Objects
parameters.name: includenonpickable
parameters.description: Includes the non-pickable objects in the picking algorithm such that non-pickable objects may occlude pickable objects.  For example, if there is only one pickable object in the scene with lots of additional non-pickable geometry is present, turning this parameter on will prevent the pickable object from being selected if it is behind a non-pickage object (occluded by the non-pickage object).

parameters.label: Picking by
parameters.name: pickingby
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the pick location is set.

parameters.label: Panel
parameters.name: panel
parameters.description: Uses the  Panel Component  scoped in the   Panel   parameter. The uv position of the mouse on this component's control panel will be the uv position in the render that is sampled. The pick is active when the panel value specified by the   Panel Value   parameter is 1.

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Uses the  U ,  V , and  Pick  parameters below for picking.

parameters.label: Panel
parameters.name: panel
parameters.description: Specifies which panel component to use when picking by panel.

parameters.label: Panel Value
parameters.name: panelvalue
parameters.description: Specifies with panel value to use to trigger the pick when picking by panel.

parameters.label: U
parameters.name: picku
parameters.description: Sets the u coordinate when picking by parameters.

parameters.label: V
parameters.name: pickv
parameters.description: Sets the v coordinate when picking by parameters.

parameters.label: Select
parameters.name: select
parameters.description: When picking by parameters, picking is active when this parameter = 1.

parameters.label: Activate Callbacks
parameters.name: activatecallbacks
parameters.description: Enables  Callback   DAT  for each pick event.

parameters.label: Callbacks  DAT
parameters.name: callbacks
parameters.description: Path  to a  DAT  containing callbacks for pick event received.

parameters.label: Fetch Point Color
parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Returns the point color of the point picked on the geometry. Channels  cr, cg, cb, ca .

parameters.label: Fetch Texture UV
parameters.name: uv
parameters.description: Returns the texture coordinates of the point picked on the geometry. Channels  mapu, mapv, mapw .

parameters.label: Fetch Object  Path
parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Return the path to the object that is picked. This result requires and  Info DAT  with its  Node  Path   parameter referecning the Render Pick  CHOP .

parameters.label: Fetch Depth
parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Returns the depth of the point picked on the geometry. This value a non-linear ratio of the point's position between the near and far planes of the  Depth Buffer . Channel is  depth .

parameters.label: Fetch  Instance  ID
parameters.name: instanceid
parameters.description: Returns the  Instance  ID of the object. This will always be 0 if instancing is off. Channel is  instance .

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope

parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

When the operator is a  Panel Component , it also cooks when a user interacts with it. When an operator cooks, it usually causes operators connected to its output to re-cook.
